theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 20 群

items.colloc: apparently true 顯然是真的 | apparently simple 看似簡單
items.distinct: obviously 明顯地（證據確鑿）| seemingly 外表上地
ex: Apparently, the merger has been delayed again.
顯然地，合併案又被延期了。
The manager is apparently unhappy with the results.
經理似乎對結果不太滿意。
He is apparently the best candidate for the job.
據說他是這份工作最好的候選人。

items.colloc: appropriate measures 適當的措施 | appropriate attire 合宜的穿著
items.distinct: proper 合宜的（禮節上）| suitable 適合的（功能上）
ex: Please wear appropriate attire to the gala.
請穿著合適的服裝參加晚宴。
The board will take appropriate action soon.
董事會很快會採取適當行動。
Is this software appropriate for our needs?
這個軟體適合我們的需求嗎？

items.pos: n. 現金 | v. 兌現
items.colloc: cash payment 現金付款 | petty cash 零用金
items.distinct: currency 通貨（國際）| fund 資金
ex: We offer a discount for cash payments.
我們提供現金付款的折扣。
Could you please cash this check for me?
你能幫我把這張支票兌現嗎？
The company is running low on cash.
公司的現金流快要不足了。

items.colloc: consult a lawyer 諮詢律師 | consult the manual 查閱手冊
items.distinct: inquire 詢問 | confer 商議
ex: You should consult a financial advisor first.
你應該先諮詢財務顧問。
Please consult the employee handbook for details.
請查閱員工手冊以了解細節。
We will consult our clients before deciding.
我們決定前會先諮詢客戶意見。

items.colloc: car dealer 汽車經銷商 | authorized dealer 授權經銷商
items.distinct: distributor 批發商 | merchant 商人
ex: He is a successful local car dealer.
他是一位成功的在地汽車經銷商。
Contact the authorized dealer for repairs.
請聯繫授權經銷商進行維修。
The art dealer sold the painting quickly.
藝術品經銷商很快就把畫賣掉了。

items.pos: n. 存款；訂金 | v. 存入
items.colloc: make a deposit 存款 | security deposit 保證金
items.distinct: down payment 頭期款 | installment 分期付款
ex: Please deposit the check into our account.
請將支票存入我們的帳戶。
We require a deposit to secure the order.
我們需要訂金來確保這筆訂單。
He made a large deposit at the bank.
他在銀行存入了一大筆錢。

items.colloc: board of directors 董事會 | marketing director 行銷總監
items.distinct: manager 經理 | executive 主管人員
ex: The marketing director will lead the project.
行銷總監將帶領這個專案。
She was appointed as the new director.
她被指派擔任新主管。
The board of directors met this morning.
董事會今天早上開會了。

items.colloc: entirely different 完全不同 | entirely new 全新的
items.distinct: completely 完全地 | totally 徹底地
ex: The office layout is entirely different now.
辦公室配置現在完全不同了。
We are entirely satisfied with the service.
我們對這項服務感到完全滿意。
His proposal is entirely new to me.
他的提議對我來說是全新的。

items.colloc: be familiar with 對...熟悉 | familiar face 熟悉的面孔
items.distinct: acquainted 認識的 | knowledgeable 博學的
ex: Are you familiar with our safety protocols?
你熟悉我們的安全規章嗎？
The system design seems quite familiar.
系統設計看起來很熟悉。
I am not familiar with this software.
我不熟悉這個軟體。

items.colloc: financial report 財務報告 | financial advisor 財務顧問
items.distinct: fiscal 會計年度的 | monetary 貨幣的
ex: The financial report shows a steady growth.
財務報告顯示穩定成長。
We need financial support for the launch.
我們需要財務支援來進行產品發表。
Financial markets are fluctuating quite often.
金融市場目前波動相當頻繁。

items.colloc: imply that... 暗示... | strongly imply 強烈暗示
items.distinct: suggest 建議；顯示 | indicate 指出
ex: His tone seemed to imply his disagreement.
他的語氣似乎暗示他不贊同。
The results imply that we should adjust.
結果意味著我們應該進行調整。
Does the email imply a change in deadline?
這封郵件暗示截止日期有變嗎？

items.pos: v. 加入；連接 | n. 接合處
items.colloc: join the company 加入公司 | join the meeting 參加會議
items.distinct: participate 參加（需加in）| attend 出席
ex: We would like you to join our team.
我們希望你加入我們的團隊。
Please join us for the annual conference.
請參加我們的年度會議。
He decided to join the professional club.
他決定加入那個專業俱樂部。

items.pos: n. 貸款；借出 | v. 借出
items.colloc: apply for a loan 申請貸款 | bank loan 銀行貸款
items.distinct: debt 債務 | mortgage 房貸
ex: The bank approved our small business loan.
銀行核准了我們的小型企業貸款。
She is currently paying off a car loan.
她目前正在償還車貸。
Can the library loan me these books?
圖書館可以借我這些書嗎？

items.colloc: at a new location 在新地點 | convenient location 便利的位置
items.distinct: site 基地；工地 | venue 場地
ex: The store is moving to a new location.
這家店即將搬到新的地點。
This is a prime location for an office.
這是非常適合辦公室的黃金地段。
We need to confirm the meeting location.
我們需要確認開會地點。

items.pos: v. 監控；監督 | n. 螢幕；監控器
items.colloc: monitor progress 監控進度 | monitor the system 監控系統
items.distinct: supervise 管理；督導 | observe 觀察
ex: We need to monitor the project closely.
我們需要密切監控這個專案。
The staff will monitor the network status.
員工將會監控網路狀態。
He bought a new computer monitor today.
他今天買了一個新的電腦螢幕。

items.colloc: passenger terminal 航廈 | airline passenger 航空乘客
items.distinct: commuter 通勤者 | traveler 旅客
ex: Passengers must check in two hours early.
乘客必須提早兩小時報到。
The train was crowded with many passengers.
火車上擠滿了許多乘客。
Please ensure all passengers are seated.
請確認所有乘客都已就座。

items.colloc: perform a task 執行任務 | perform well 表現良好
items.distinct: execute 執行（指令）| conduct 進行（活動）
ex: Our team performs well under high pressure.
我們的團隊在高壓下表現良好。
The technician will perform a routine check.
技術人員將執行例行檢查。
He is able to perform his duties well.
他能夠很好地履行職責。

items.colloc: predict the outcome 預測結果 | accurately predict 精準預測
items.distinct: forecast 預報（天氣/數據）| foresee 預見
ex: Experts predict that sales will increase soon.
專家預測銷售額很快會增加。
It is hard to predict future market trends.
很難預測未來的市場趨勢。
Can you predict the result of the test?
你能預測測試的結果嗎？

items.pos: n. 比率；費用；等級 | v. 評估
items.colloc: interest rate 利率 | hourly rate 時薪
items.distinct: fee 費用（服務）| price 價格
ex: The interest rate for the loan is low.
貸款的利率很低。
Our hourly rate for consulting is fixed.
我們的諮詢時薪是固定的。
How would you rate this new product?
你會如何評價這項新產品？

items.colloc: regularly updated 定期更新 | check regularly 定期檢查
items.distinct: frequently 頻繁地 | occasionally 偶爾地
ex: We update the company website regularly.
我們會定期更新公司網站。
Please check your email regularly for news.
請定期檢查電子郵件以獲取消息。
The equipment is serviced regularly by staff.
設備由員工定期進行保養。
